---
title: "2 December — Individual research-design meetings"
description: "One-on-one meetings with the instructor"
---

The scheduled class period is used for individual meetings with the instructor about the final research design. There is no lecture, collective reading discussion, coding walkthrough or weekly recording.

Submit the final research-design memo before your scheduled meeting. Submission and scheduling details will be circulated to the class.

Come prepared to discuss:

- the sociological question and contribution;
- the evidence or data the project would require;
- the precise role of the LLM;
- one concrete input → operation → output example;
- the most important validation problem;
- what should be emphasized in the presentation.

The meeting is developmental rather than separately graded. Scheduling details will be circulated to the class.
